name: Mavis
source: MAVIS_MANUAL_V2_06.27.2022.pdf p.36 (The Patchbay, panel diagram) and pp.36-44 jack descriptions
notes: 24-point patchbay, 13 inputs / 11 outputs (outputs in reverse text on panel). HP/VCA is the panel's headphone-symbol /VCA jack (R1;C1): headphone or line-level main output, -5 to +5V. ONE (-5) is normalled to -5V and ATTN (+5) to +5V; S+H (VCO) normalled to VCO, S+H GATE (LFO) normalled to LFO. MULT is passive: MULT input feeds MULT 1 and MULT 2. 12V DC barrel power is on the rear, not listed.
